public_infrastructure.note: The proposed evaluation (Tier 1 claim verification) runs here with no GPU, API key, or network.

source_urls.note: External scanners and base models are NOT redistributed; they are fetched from these URLs at run time.

proposed_evaluation_tier1_cpu.description: Regenerates the 12 claimed tables/figures (Tables 3-8, 10, 11, Figures 4-6) from the bundled scanner-verdict CSVs and prints PASS/FAIL.

full_reproduction_optional_gpu.disk: ~10 GB artifact + ~2.5 GB LoRA adapters + ~15 GB base model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B)
full_reproduction_optional_gpu.gpu: 1x NVIDIA A100 80 GB (>= 24 GB VRAM for a single 7-9B scanner)
full_reproduction_optional_gpu.api_key: OpenAI (paid); read from a local .env, never bundled
full_reproduction_optional_gpu.runtime: ~3 h+ (mutation benchmark) + ~1-2 h on the A100 (fine-tuning demo), estimated
full_reproduction_optional_gpu.cost: ~$30+ API, expected ~$200 (mutation benchmark) + ~$1-2 GPU and < $1 API (fine-tuning demo), estimated
full_reproduction_optional_gpu.description: Tier 4: full live mutation benchmark (3 oracles, gpt-5.4 judge, cross scans) + a fine-tuning training demo (5-step LoRA run) and released-adapter inference. Paper-scale training of the four base families is not automated; its results are verified at Tier 1. See README 'Tier 4 stage breakdown'.

allocation.proposed_evaluation: No allocation required; runs on free public infrastructure.
allocation.full_reproduction: Optional, justified constraint (security-sensitive generation + GPU training). Needs a reviewer-provided NVIDIA A100 80 GB: a rented cloud A100 (RunPod / Lambda / vast.ai, ~$1.10-1.79/h) or an institutional GPU server. This is NOT the proposed evaluation task and exceeds a one-day review budget.
allocation.reviewer_access: On request the authors provide anonymous SSH access to a preconfigured A100 80 GB box (climbkim@kaist.ac.kr), satisfying the AE requirement that required private infrastructure be made available to reviewers.

software_setup.os: Linux (macOS / Windows via WSL or Git Bash also work); Tier 1 tested on Ubuntu 22.04 (Python 3.12), Linux (Python 3.10), macOS (Python 3.12), Google Colab and Windows Git Bash (Python 3.14).
software_setup.python: >= 3.10 (tested 3.10, 3.12 and 3.14; Google Colab compatible); the fine-tuning extras (install.sh --finetune / --all) need 3.10-3.12 (GPU path tested with 3.10)

install../install.sh: core (pandas, numpy, pyyaml, openpyxl) -> Tier 1 CPU verification (public infrastructure)
install../install.sh --generate: + openai, langchain-core/-openai, langgraph, tiktoken, python-dotenv, matplotlib, snyk-agent-scan==0.4.9, skill-security-scan -> live mutation/scan (REQUIRES OpenAI key)
install../install.sh --finetune: + torch==2.6.0, transformers==4.55.4, peft==0.20.0, trl==0.21.0, datasets==3.6.0, accelerate==1.10.1, vllm==0.8.5.post1, huggingface_hub==0.36.2, sentencepiece==0.2.0 -> training / local scanner (REQUIRES GPU)
